- Client Secret : `<YOUR_CLIENT_SECRET>`
- Refresh Token : `<YOUR_REFRESH_TOKEN>`

```python
response = authenticate_travel(
    client_id="<YOUR_CLIENT_ID>",
    client_secret="<YOUR_CLIENT_SECRET>",

    grant_type="read_write",
    user_first_name="YourFirstName",
    user_last_name="YourLastName"
)
```

返回值中包含 `"access_token"`，把它帶入下一步：

```python
invoice = retrieve_invoice(access_token=<ACCESS_TOKEN>, booking_id=<BOOKING_ID>)
```
